Title: Hey LSJ!! Giovanni/Ravnos whats the deal?

Messages.Author: David Bonin
Messages.Body:
Hi,
I have been playing vampire for a couple of months and noticed that
there are cards in dark soveriens that give giovanni or ravnos all of
the benefits of camarilla vampires. What are these benefits?? Nothing I
have found seems to explain these at all. My suspicion is that they are
not allowed to vote in a vote called by a camarilla and they are not
allowed to hold a title but I am not sure. Please clarify this for me.

Thanks in advance,
Dave

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
In article <34C3B498...@fids.ce.umanitoba.ca>, David Bonin wrote:
>Hi,
> I have been playing vampire for a couple of months and noticed that
>there are cards in dark soveriens that give giovanni or ravnos all of
>the benefits of camarilla vampires. What are these benefits?? Nothing I
>have found seems to explain these at all. My suspicion is that they are
>not allowed to vote in a vote called by a camarilla and they are not
>allowed to hold a title

Normally, they may participate in any vote. They may not gain camarilla
titles, but they keep those they already posess.

>but I am not sure. Please clarify this for me.

Non camarilla vampires cannot
-- become princes or primogens
-- call any of the following votes:
Praxis Siezure (any)
Justicar Retribution
Command of the Harpies
Masquerade Enforcement
vote to burn Elesium: the Arboretum
vote to burn Masquerade Enforcement
Camarilla Exemplary
-- be chosen as Archons or Camarilla Exemplaries.

Other benefits are dependent on card text. For instance:

Closed Session: Excludes non-camarilla vamps from voting.
Imperial Decree: Allows camarilla vamps to attack non-camarilla vampires
as an action.
Judgement: Camarilla Segregation: A few of these in play can make you
really wish for a Ravnos Acceptance card.

Being Camarilla has a few disadvantages though:

-- cannot vote during Cardinal Benediction
-- cannot play Covenant of Blood, nor benefit from its effects
-- cannot still be "Sabbat" and gain any advantages thereof

Did I miss anything?
